detailed_findings.finding: The proof correctly uses the image subset f(X) ⊆ Y and finiteness of Y to infer |f(X)| ≤ |Y|.
The proof correctly observes that f viewed as X → f(X) is surjective by definition of image and injective by hypothesis, hence bijective.
The conclusion |X| = |f(X)| ≤ |Y| is valid and establishes the desired inequality with no missing cases.

reason: The proof is mathematically correct and complete for finite sets: it forms the image f(X) ⊆ Y, uses injectivity to show f : X → f(X) is a bijection, concludes |X| = |f(X)|, and combines this with |f(X)| ≤ |Y|. This matches the lemma statement exactly and supports the root theorem role of turning an injection into a cardinality inequality.
